subject: Vendor setup: split-payment-lane proposal and payment-term options
messages:

Subject: Vendor setup: next steps on PO/terms and onboarding packet

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference — excited to get Novalyte live. To finish vendor setup on our side we need a couple quick items from procurement:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached our PDF)
- W9 or equivalent tax doc (you can attach the file reply)
- Typical PO cadence and the billing contact for AP invoices

One item to surface early: billing cadence / payment terms. Finance will default new vendors to Net 30, but we sometimes do split-lane arrangements for customers who have subscription and project work (e.g., subscription invoices Net 30, professional services Net 45). If Novalyte has specific constraints or a PO numbering format, send that along and we can map it into our AP workflow.

I've attached the onboarding form — feel free to sign and return. If you'd like, we can propose a small incentives-based early-pay option (ACH enrollment + 1% fee) to accelerate services invoices.

Quick ask: can you confirm procurement contact, PO lead time, and whether a single PO will cover both subscription and services?

Best,

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — attached is our standard supplier packet (W9 included). A few quick answers:

- Procurement contact: procurement@novalyte.com (CC'd)
- PO cadence: We issue POs monthly for subscription and on a project-by-project basis for professional services.
- Preferred payment term: our finance team typically asks for Net 30, but we have flexibility to accept Net 45 for large one-off services engagements if that helps.

On the early-pay note — we can consider an accelerated remit for services invoices if Redwood offers a modest discount/fee structure. What does the ACH enrollment process look like on your side?

I attached the W9 and vendor registration form. Let me know if you need anything signed or if a DocuSign copy is easier.

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Novalyte's packet. Their ask: default Net 30, but OK to accept Net 45 on larger services projects. They also asked about an early-pay option.

Notes/context: Novalyte is expected to start with a SaaS subscription plus an initial 8-week integration project (SOW attached in the pipeline). Sales (Karthik) — do you expect a single PO or separate POs? If separate, we should map to two AP lanes so that subscription invoices don't get delayed by project approval cycles.

Marissa — can AP accommodate a split-lane setup (subscription: Net 30; services: Net 45) without creating extra manual work? Also flag any risk or insurance requirements. If we can offer an accelerated remit (ACH) at 1% fee, would that be reasonable from our side?

Thanks — Naomi

Thanks Naomi — quick AP read: we can map vendors to multiple invoice lanes so subscription invoices can follow Net 30 and project invoices can be Net 45. A few operational notes:

- We'll ask for PO line-item tagging (one PO per subscription line vs. one per project SOW) so our system can route automatically.
- When vendors request an accelerated remit, our standard is ACH enrollment + early-pay portal (we currently offer up to 2% fee for pay on-demand; for newly onboarded vendors we prefer 1% for first 90 days as a pilot).
- Insurance/terms: no special requirements beyond our standard vendor master checks for Novalyte's size, but run legal if they push on data residency or SLAs tied to payment terms.

I'm attaching the vendor-risk-profile we completed for Novalyte during the qualification call. If Sales confirms separate POs, we'll wire up the lanes and sample PO templates that show the required tagging.

Marissa Cole

Hi Elena — looping back with a proposed path to get you fully onboarded and avoid invoice routing delays. Summary below and next steps (mutual action plan):

Proposed payment mapping
- Subscription (monthly product fees): Net 30, send to AP with PO code SUBS-<PO#>
- Professional services / SOW-based work: Net 45 by default, send separate PO per project with PO code PROJ-<PO#>
- Early-pay option (optional): ACH enrollment + Redwood early-pay portal. Pilot fee: 1% for first 90 days, then standard tier up to 2% thereafter if you opt in.

AP requirements
- Taggable PO lines (we will send sample PO templates)
- Invoice PDFs with PO number in the first page header
- Single AP mailbox: ap-invoices@redwood.com

Action items
- Elena / Novalyte: sign and return the attached onboarding form (I can send DocuSign if easier) and confirm whether you prefer a combined PO for both lanes or separate POs for subscription vs project work.
- Novalyte: confirm ACH details if you want the early-pay pilot (we'll send secure upload link).
- Karthik: please confirm SOW cadence and whether Sales will request a one-time exception for any milestone-based holds.

If this looks good I'll send the DocuSign onboarding form and the PO template examples. Thanks all — looking forward to getting Novalyte billing flows mapped so invoices don't get held up during the first project milestone.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
